Publication statement: Roma : Presso la Calcograf[i]a cam[era]le, 1790.

Relief shown pictorially. Gores for a 34 cm. globe. All sheets folded horizontally, with paper hinges on verso, and traces of color on edges. Some acid offset on gore sheets. Four sheets of gores and 1 sheet with zodiacs and 2 polar calottes. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Gift; Summit Enterprise, Inc.; May 2003.
